release_note: Launched as Beta (decision 2026-10-05): misses most ticks on close-up phone photos (web close-ups caught 5/35). The app shows a Beta badge and invites farmers to contribute tick photos (opt-in) to build a close-up training set; see README 'Beta and photo collection'.
pipeline: stretch photo to 640x640; COCO animal box + 10% pad (whole photo if none); 96x96 patches, stride 48
patch_input: RGB 96x96, (x - ImageNet mean*255) / (std*255), NCHW float32; output logit
selection: model, rule and calibration chosen on val only; test reported once (reports/tick_evaluation.json)
training: MobileNetV2 (ImageNet) patch classifier, PyTorch; variant B: 30% of negative patches from presumed tick-free rf16 cows (scripts/train_patch_classifier.py --name tick_patch_B --rf-neg-frac 0.3)
output: image score = mean of the 5 highest patch probabilities; p = sigmoid(A * logit(score) + B), equal prior odds
confidence_rules: a 'healthy' verdict is never 'high': the model misses ticks on close-up web photos with p near 0 (reports/tick_evaluation.json, external_web_sanity)

ui_wording.affected: 'Ticks detected' (low confidence: 'Possible ticks'); advice: see a vet / treat
ui_wording.healthy: 'No ticks seen in this photo' (+ 'check the animal by hand, especially ears, neck, dewlap, udder and tail base; ask a vet if unsure')
ui_wording.never: no 'not sure' verdict; low confidence changes wording and advice only

evaluation: reports/tick_evaluation.json (grouped split, group-bootstrap 95% CIs); selection: reports/tick_selection_val.json
external_web_sanity: 35 unique web photos of infested animals: 5 called affected (one of them a goat with ringworm). Not validation.
limitations: positives come from one Roboflow set: a few Hereford calves in one crush pen (6 test groups); tick-free images are mostly other-source dairy/CCTV cows, so part of the AUC measures source, not ticks
fails on close-up / other-farm tick photos: 4 of 34 web cattle-tick photos caught
only 7 tick-free Griffith images in test: within-pen specificity is essentially unmeasured
no field phone photos anywhere in train/val/test
rf16 'tick-free' cows are presumed, not labelled for ticks
